verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a REST API ('The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk'), but nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so no versioned spec could be confirmed either. A plain API without versioning or deprecation guarantees does not deliver this story, and this applicable capability has no evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
